Action: [Answer]
Content: When applying nail polish, ensure you use a base coat to protect your nails and prevent staining. Apply thin, even layers of polish, allowing each coat to dry completely before adding the next to avoid smudges. Finish with a top coat for durability and a polished look. Additionally, choose a well-ventilated area and avoid shaking the polish bottle vigorously to prevent air bubbles. If adding color, select shades that complement your style and let each layer dry thoroughly for a smooth finish.
